headline: Canada Challenges Russia’s Nuclear Influence in Turkey With Proposed 4.5-Gigawatt Power Plant
facebook_description: Canada has signed a feasibility agreement for a potential 4.5 GW nuclear project in Turkey, where Russia is already building the 4.8 GW Akkuyu plant. Could a Canadian project diversify Turkey’s energy partnerships? No construction contract has been awarded. #EPNews #NuclearEnergy #Turkey #Canada #Russia
